To the index: your ACL, in code, at query time.
To Genie: Unity Catalog, per caller.
Both run on the caller's credentials.

div.span: Enforcing the ACL at query time means no per-audience index and no copy of the corpus outside Databricks. The trade is that the access decision runs in code you wrote on the serve side, against columns you chose on the build side.
